turns.question: What was our refund rate by value on the orders placed on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no value-based refund rate; its only return rate is the Return rate (returns over orders by count), which was 10 % for orders placed 1-2 October 2026 (3 returns), and the closest value metrics are Returns (EUR) and Revenue (EUR). Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
